patterns.note: Sections frequently use a full-width background with content constrained to a central column, often featuring generous vertical padding.
A high-contrast, vibrant palette is used, pairing deep black and crisp white with energetic lime green and teal accents, often applied as duotone filters on imagery.
A bold, wide sans-serif typeface is used for prominent headings, contrasted with a playful, hand-drawn script font for key accent words like 'Culture' and 'a while'.
Major content blocks and sections reveal with a subtle animation as they scroll into the viewport, creating a dynamic reading experience.
The hero section features a striking split-tone image treatment, dividing the visual field with two distinct color filters (lime green and teal) and overlaid text.

technique_notes: To achieve the scroll-triggered reveals, elements should be initially styled with zero opacity and a slight vertical offset. As they enter the viewport, CSS keyframe animations are triggered to transition them smoothly to full opacity and their natural position, creating a fade-up effect.

The split-tone hero image effect can be created by layering two semi-transparent color overlays with different blend modes over a single background image, or by using two separate image elements with distinct color filters applied, positioned side-by-side.

The hand-drawn underline effect on specific text can be implemented using an SVG path animation that draws the line dynamically, or by animating a CSS border-bottom property with a custom SVG background for the wavy texture.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body) create strong visual impact, complemented by a playful script font for emphasis and standard sans-serif body copy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding is applied to interactive elements like buttons and project cards, while most structural elements and images maintain sharp, angular corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, with significant vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, creating a sense of openness, while content grids maintain a balanced density.

standout: This site distinguishes itself with a bold, high-contrast color scheme that uses vibrant lime green and teal as duotone filters on imagery, creating a modern and energetic feel. The unexpected integration of a playful, hand-drawn script font for key words against the otherwise industrial sans-serif typography adds a unique, human touch that breaks from typical corporate real estate aesthetics.
